source.content: @isTest private class MessagingTemplateCapacityEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { EmailTemplate tmpl = [SELECT Id, Subject, Body FROM EmailTemplate WHERE DeveloperName = 'Trail_Template' LIMIT 1]; Case parent = new Case(Subject = 'Trail case'); insert parent; EmailMessage first = new EmailMessage(ParentId = parent.Id, Subject = 'Trail draft one', FromAddress = 'sender@example.com', ToAddress = 'recipient@example.com', Status = '5'); EmailMessage second = new EmailMessage(ParentId = parent.Id, Subject = 'Trail draft two', FromAddress = 'sender@example.com', ToAddress = 'recipient@example.com', Status = '5'); EmailMessage third = new EmailMessage(ParentId = parent.Id, Subject = 'Trail draft three', FromAddress = 'sender@example.com', ToAddress = 'recipient@example.com', Status = '5'); insert new List<EmailMessage>{first, second, third}; List<Messaging.RenderEmailTemplateBodyResult> rendered = Messaging.renderEmailTemplate(null, null, new List<String>{'Hello trail', 'Account trail'}); System.assertEquals(2, rendered.size()); System.assert(rendered.get(0).getSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Hello trail', rendered.get(0).getMergedBody()); System.assertEquals(null, rendered.get(0).getErrors()); System.assertEquals('Account trail', rendered.get(1).getMergedBody()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage stored = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate(tmpl.Id, null, null); System.assertEquals('Trail subject', stored.getSubject()); System.assertEquals('Trail body', stored.getPlainTextBody()); Messaging.reserveSingleEmailCapacity(3); Messaging.reserveMassEmailCapacity(3); List<Messaging.SendEmailResult> results = Messaging.sendEmailMessage(new List<Id>{first.Id, second.Id}, false); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assert(results.get(0).isSuccess()); System.assert(results.get(1).isSuccess()); List<Messaging.SendEmailResult> defaulted = Messaging.sendEmailMessage(new List<Id>{third.Id}); System.assertEquals(1, defaulted.size()); System.assert(defaulted.get(0).isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(2, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); } }
